OpenSpec Agentic Kit: A Deterministic Pipeline for Claude Code Agents

A dependency-free Node.js runner that drives ten headless Claude Code agents through OpenSpec changes across many repos. The runner holds all control flow: it reads OpenSpec status, runs deterministic checks including a spec-to-test trace, caps retries and budget, and stops at four risk-based human approval gates.
